item_short_desc: Rothco’s Canteen and Cover is a reliable hydration solution for outdoor enthusiasts. The canteen is crafted from durable, BPA-free plastic and holds up to 1 quart of water. Its accompanying felt-lined polyester cover provides excellent insulation to keep your water temperature consistent. The cover includes a secure 2-button snap closure, a belt clip for hands-free carrying, and an external tab pouch for small accessories.
